opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed the crew’s teamwork, the energetic space action, and the episode’s comedic character interactions.
Several viewers liked the crystal-creature animation and found the episode entertaining and fast-moving.
Some appreciated the imaginative action concepts, while others felt the battle logic and technical presentation strained believability.
A few commenters criticized the episode’s visual quality and subtitle or production errors during the space battle.
